description: Authentication pages and API routes. Depends on FEAT-001. The login and register pages already exist and work. This FEAT adds the missing auth flow pages (forgot-password, reset-password, verify-email) and their API routes, plus the logout API route. Also adds the AuthContext from FEAT-001 to the root layout so all portals can use it.
steps:
Step 1 — Missing auth API routes. (a) d:
ew tution website\src\app\api\auth orgot-passwordoute.ts — POST: validate email with forgotPasswordSchema (already in validations.ts). Find user by email. If found: generate resetToken (generateResetToken()), set resetToken + resetExpiry (1 hour from now) on user. In production, send email (stub: console.log the reset link). Always return same 200 response ('If an account exists for this email, a reset link has been sent.') to prevent user enumeration. (b) d:
ew tution website\src\app\api\autheset-passwordoute.ts — POST: validate with resetPasswordSchema (token + password). Find user where resetToken matches AND resetExpiry > now. If valid: hash new password, update passwordHash, clear resetToken + resetExpiry, set status ACTIVE if PENDING_VERIFICATION. Return 200. (c) d:
ew tution website\src\app\api\auth\verify-emailoute.ts — GET: accepts ?token= query param. Find user where verifyToken matches AND verifyExpiry > now. If found: set emailVerified:true, status:ACTIVE, clear verifyToken+verifyExpiry. Redirect to /login?verified=1. (d) d:
ew tution website\src\app\api\auth\logoutoute.ts — POST: clear auth_token cookie (maxAge:0), return 200. This is in addition to the DELETE /api/auth/me that already exists.

Step 2 — Forgot password page. d:\new tution website\src\app\forgot-password\page.tsx — 'use client'. Split-panel layout matching login/register pages. Form: email input. On submit: POST /api/auth/forgot-password. On success: show confirmation message ('Check your email for a reset link — in development, check the server console.'). No metadata export on client pages — add a separate layout.tsx or use the default. Actually: export metadata from a parent layout is fine, but for a 'use client' page, use a wrapper or use generateMetadata. Decision: wrap with a minimal server component that exports metadata and renders the client form. Pattern: create page.tsx as server component exporting metadata + rendering a client ForgetPasswordForm component.

Step 3 — Reset password page. d:\new tution website\src\app\reset-password\page.tsx — 'use client'. Reads ?token= from URL (useSearchParams). Form: password + confirm password. Validates match client-side. POST /api/auth/reset-password with token+password. On success: redirect to /login?reset=1. Show appropriate error if token invalid/expired.

Step 4 — Verify email page. d:\new tution website\src\app\verify-email\page.tsx — server component. Reads searchParams.token. If token present: fetch /api/auth/verify-email?token=... (or call prisma directly since it's a server component). Show success or error message. If no token: show 'Check your email' message. Add metadata export.

Step 5 — Login page enhancement. Update d:\new tution website\src\app\login\page.tsx: (a) Read searchParams for ?verified=1 and ?reset=1 — show success banners ('Email verified successfully! You can now sign in.' / 'Password reset successfully. Please sign in with your new password.'). Since the existing login page is 'use client', pass these via a server wrapper component or read from URL client-side with useSearchParams. Decision: the login page is already 'use client', so use useSearchParams() to read the params and show banners. (b) After successful login, the existing redirect logic is correct — no changes needed to the POST /api/auth/login route.

Step 6 — Add AuthContext to root layout. Update d:\new tution website\src\app\layout.tsx: wrap children with <AuthProvider> from src/context/AuthContext.tsx. Since AuthContext is 'use client', the AuthProvider must be imported in a separate client wrapper component to avoid making the entire layout client-side. Create d:\new tution website\src\components\providers\Providers.tsx as a 'use client' component that wraps children with AuthProvider. Import Providers in layout.tsx and wrap the body children.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/auth/forgot-password returns 200 with generic message for any email input
POST /api/auth/reset-password returns 400 for invalid/expired token, 200 for valid
GET /api/auth/verify-email?token= redirects to /login?verified=1 on valid token
src/app/reset-password/page.tsx exists with password + confirm form reading ?token=
AuthContext is wired into the root layout via Providers.tsx
verification: cd 'd:\new tution website' && npm run lint
cd 'd:\new tution website' && npm run build
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Build passes (exit 0), lint clean (0 warnings), tsc --noEmit clean (exit 0). Key notes: (1) POST /api/auth/forgot-password always returns 200 with generic message regardless of whether email exists — prevents user enumeration. Console.log stub outputs reset link in development. (2) POST /api/auth/reset-password checks both resetToken match AND resetExpiry > now (gt: new Date()); returns 400 for invalid/expired token; activates PENDING_VERIFICATION accounts on success. (3) GET /api/auth/verify-email redirects to /login?verified=1 on valid token, /login?verified=error on invalid/expired. (4) POST /api/auth/logout clears auth_token cookie (maxAge:0) — complements existing DELETE /api/auth/me. (5) src/app/forgot-password/page.tsx is a server component exporting metadata; client form is in ForgotPasswordForm.tsx. (6) src/app/reset-password/page.tsx is a server component; client form in ResetPasswordForm.tsx wraps useSearchParams() in <Suspense>. (7) src/app/verify-email/page.tsx is a server component calling Prisma directly; shows check-email message when no token, success/error states when token present. (8) src/app/login/page.tsx updated: LoginForm inner component uses useSearchParams() for ?verified=1 and ?reset=1 banners; wrapped in <Suspense> in default export. (9) src/components/providers/Providers.tsx created as 'use client' wrapper around AuthProvider; imported in layout.tsx which remains a server component.
